title: Keep a tiny assignment inline without creating a handoff document

rubric.text: Keeps this tiny standalone assignment in a concise inline brief because there is no existing plan, task record, or evidence record worth pointing to.
Does not require creating a new plan, packet, receipt, notes file, or other document solely to support the handoff.
Still states the one-file objective and scope, exact checkout/base, allowed and forbidden actions, acceptance check, blocker path, and no-further-delegation boundary.

If a fresh independent audit is actually assigned, supplies a self-contained review brief with its source, base/candidate, standard, verdict, and coverage; does not add a reviewer or review phase to this task.
Makes no dispatch or file changes.
